keyword_expectations.owner: old hatch rim and separate structural ribs
keyword_expectations.baseline_evidence: The chamber's old silver hatch rim shows rubbed edges, gray oxidation patches and fine scratches; thick black-iron structural ribs behind it are darker, rougher and pitted
keyword_expectations.pixel_pass: A light silvery hatch rim visibly carries rubbed or scratched wear; separate dark iron-colored ribs have a rough surface. A single uniform shiny metal object is insufficient.
keyword_expectations.limits: Pixels support metal appearance and wear, not chemical silver or iron composition.

keyword_expectations.baseline_evidence: Several separate clear water droplets cling to the porthole glass above the latch, with rounded bright rims and tiny refracted highlights
keyword_expectations.pixel_pass: Several discrete bead-shaped transparent droplets with rims and local highlights are visible on the intended pane. Uniform glare, grain or an undifferentiated wet smear fails this criterion.
keyword_expectations.limits: A still photograph does not prove real water chemistry.

keyword_expectations.baseline_evidence: slim contoured shoulder plates and narrow forearm shells over flexible fitted fabric, articulated dark joints
keyword_expectations.pixel_pass: The subject's suit has a streamlined fitted outline and visibly separate slim hard shoulder/forearm pieces with flexible dark joints. A generic cloth jacket or bulky knight armor fails.
keyword_expectations.limits: Science-fiction styling is an authored aesthetic judgment.

keyword_expectations.owner: subject right arm and release lever
keyword_expectations.baseline_evidence: Her right arm extends toward the chest-height release lever, with a softly bent elbow and a straight wrist
keyword_expectations.pixel_pass: A connected shoulder-to-elbow-to-wrist-to-hand chain visibly reaches the lever, and the gloved hand physically grips it. A nearby hovering hand, concealed hand or unrelated arm fails.
keyword_expectations.limits: A single frame cannot verify movement speed.

keyword_expectations.owner: room glass and brushed steel panels
keyword_expectations.baseline_evidence: The glass, old metal and long brushed-steel panels catch cold cyan ceiling light in distinct bounded reflections
keyword_expectations.pixel_pass: Cool cyan or blue light and bounded reflections visibly belong to glass and metal room surfaces. An overall blue tint without reflective surface cues is partial rather than full success.
keyword_expectations.limits: Cold color appearance does not prove ambient temperature.

keyword_expectations.owner: machine latch assembly and adjacent damp edge
keyword_expectations.baseline_evidence: The small crimson lamp is built into the latch assembly and casts a confined red reflection along the nearest damp metal edge
keyword_expectations.pixel_pass: An identifiable small crimson light source on the machine casts local illumination or reflection on the nearby apparatus. Red fabric, red staining or a detached red light fails this ownership criterion.
keyword_expectations.limits: A still frame cannot prove the lamp changed from flickering to steady.
keyword_expectations.source_meaning_ko: 기계에서 나는 붉은 빛; 피가 아님

scene_expectations.owner: hand, lever, hatch slit and adjacent lamp
scene_expectations.pixel_pass: The visible hand acts on the same apparatus whose narrow opening and local red lamp are seen. Do not infer a previous power outage or successful restart from pixels alone.
The subject retains the short dark bob, separated fringe, dark large eyes and recognizable face proportions of the supplied portrait at the chosen view. Assess visual resemblance only.

strict_status_rule: Each criterion is pass, partial, fail or not_assessable from inspected native pixels. Prompt or runtime audit pass is never counted as pixel pass. Overall all-keyword success requires all six keyword criteria to pass. No user acceptance is inferred.
